assembly: For each trait, concatenate sharedTraitPrompt, one space, the subject, and a period.
cratePrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production dark medieval strategy-game UI sprite, matching the existing resource-language-v1 'readable relics' PNG icons. Primary request: generic STOCK represented by one sturdy sealed wooden supply crate, straight-on three-quarter view, heavy plank faces and two broad brass corner straps, a small dark recess beneath the lid. One centered object occupying about 84% of a square canvas with clear margin. Bold silhouette recognizable at 22 screen pixels. Warm aged wood, muted antique brass, bone highlights, deep slate shadows; only a few broad tones, crisp deliberately chunky pixel-art clusters as if designed at 48x48 and enlarged. Consistent upper-left light. True transparent RGBA background. No contents spilling out, no letters, runes, labels, numbers, insignia, decorative border, ground shadow, glow, scenery, or other objects. Single icon, not a sheet or mockup.
sharedTraitPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE production dark medieval strategy-game Stock Trait UI sprite, matching existing resource-language-v1 'readable relics' PNG icons. Square canvas. One centered emblem occupying about 84%, clear margin, bold recognizable silhouette at 22 pixels. Aged brass, bone silver, warm earthy colors and cool slate shadow; three or four broad tones, restrained carved wear, crisp chunky pixel-art clusters as if designed at 48x48 and enlarged. Front view, upper-left light. True transparent RGBA background. No text, letters, numbers, runes, captions, border, badge, ground shadow, scenery, glow, or other objects. Single icon, not a sheet.
